svg.text: Built with Supabase, GitHub Actions & Claude
One tap on an iPhone records an expense.
It is validated, stored, labeled and
audited by AI, with no manual bookkeeping.
NFC / Wallet tap, manual hub, receipt photo
Keyword labels; vision model reads receipts
Nightly Claude routine fixes labels and learns
RLS on every table, no secrets in code
From a tap to a trusted ledger.
